detail.abstract: Korea’s Official Development Assistance (ODA) has recently experienced rapid growth, surpassing 6 trillion KRW in 2025. However, according to the Ministry of Economy and Finance’s 2026 budget proposal, the ODA budget is projected to decrease by approximately 1.2 trillion KRW to 5.3 trillion KRW compared to the previous year. While budgetary adjustments due to the national fiscal situation are necessary, Korea’s ODA/GNI ratio remains at 0.21%, falling short of the OECD Development Assistance Committee (DAC) member average of 0.33%. Therefore, securing financial resources for development is crucial for Korea to remain a responsible contributor to the international community. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨韩国官方发展援助（ODA）预算从2025年超6万亿韩元降至2026年5.3万亿韩元的背景，指出韩国ODA/GNI比率（0.21%）低于OECD DAC成员国平均水平（0.33%），强调为维持国际责任需确保发展融资来源。
AI.research_question: 韩国如何在财政紧缩背景下确保ODA资金可持续性，以履行国际发展援助责任？
AI.motivation: 韩国ODA快速增长后遭遇预算大幅削减，且ODA/GNI比率远低于OECD DAC平均水平，亟需探讨资金保障方案以维持国际贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际发展援助理论、公共财政预算理论、ODA/GNI比率标准框架
AI.method: 基于韩国政府预算数据（2025-2026年）及OECD DAC统计数据的比较分析
AI.findings: ①韩国2026年ODA预算削减约1.2万亿韩元（降至5.3万亿）；②ODA/GNI比率仅0.21%，低于DAC均值0.33%；③财政紧缩与援助承诺之间存在张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了新兴援助国在财政紧缩期的发展融资困境研究，丰富了ODA预算决策的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国政府及类似新兴援助国提供ODA资金可持续性策略建议，助力调整预算分配以符合国际承诺。

title: Autonomous CI/CD Quality Assurance Using LangGraph Multi-Agent Orchestration and Risk-Proportionate HITL Control

detail.title: Autonomous CI/CD Quality Assurance Using LangGraph Multi-Agent Orchestration and Risk-Proportionate HITL Control
detail.abstract: Modern software delivery requires quality assurance that scales with development velocity. Manual test coordination, sequential test execution, and static risk assessment create bottlenecks that constrain release frequency and accumulate quality debt. This paper presents the K11tech Agentic AI QA System, a LangGraph-orchestrated multi-agent framework that automates the full CI/CD quality gate-from pull request analysis to defect filing-without requiring manual QA intervention for routine changes. The system orchestrates 14 specialist AI agents across four pipeline phases, decouples agent logic from external tools via seven Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and incorporates a risk-proportionate human-in-the-loop gate for high-risk changes. A self-evaluation layer using DeepEval and RAGAS continuously audits the quality of the system's own LLM-generated outputs. Experimental evaluation on 120 pull requests across three open-source repositories demonstrates a mean pipeline execution time of 8.3 minutes (σ = 1.9 min), an 87% reduction in Phase 2 execution time through parallel dispatch, a defect detection rate of 91.2% against a manually validated ground truth, and zero false-negative escapes to production during the evaluation period. The system is fully open source and deployable via a single Docker Compose command.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了K11tech Agentic AI QA系统，一个基于LangGraph的多智能体框架，能够在CI/CD流水线中自动化质量门禁，无需人工干预常规变更。该系统在120个PR上的实验显示，平均执行时间8.3分钟，缺陷检测率91.2%，且评估期内零假阴性逃逸到生产环境。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可扩展的、多智能体协作的自动化质量保证系统，以消除CI/CD流水线中的人工作业瓶颈（手动测试协调、串行执行和静态风险评估），同时保持高质量标准？
AI.motivation: 现代软件交付需要与开发速度相匹配的质量保证能力。手动测试协调、串行测试执行和静态风险评估造成了瓶颈，限制了发布频率并积累了质量债务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体系统（Multi-Agent Systems）、LangGraph编排框架、Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器架构、风险比例的人机回环机制（Risk-Proportionate Human-in-the-Loop）、LLM输出质量自评估（DeepEval和RAGAS）。
AI.method: 构建了14个专业AI智能体，分布在四个流水线阶段（拉取请求分析到缺陷提交）；通过7个MCP服务器解耦智能体逻辑与外部工具；引入风险比例的人机回环门控；使用DeepEval和RAGAS进行LLM输出质量自审计。在三个开源代码库的120个PR上进行了实验评估。
AI.findings: 平均流水线执行时间8.3分钟（标准差1.9分钟）；通过并行分发，第二阶段执行时间减少87%；缺陷检测率达到91.2%（基于人工验证的真实数据）；评估期内零假阴性逃逸到生产环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一种基于LangGraph的多智能体QA编排架构，将14个专业智能体组织到四个流水线阶段中；2. 引入了风险比例的人机回环机制，在高风险变更时保留人工审核，而不妨碍低风险变更的自动化；3. 提出利用DeepEval和RAGAS对LLM输出进行持续质量审计的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 实现了全开源的、可通过单条Docker Compose命令部署的自动化QA系统；2. 实证证明了多智能体并行执行在CI/CD场景中的效率提升（87%的阶段时间缩减）；3. 展示了AI QA系统可实现91.2%的缺陷检测率和零假阴性逃逸，具有实际部署可行性。

title: Screwworm Border Closure and Cattle Prices Heterogeneous Spatio-Temporal Effects of the Screwworm-Induced Border Closure on US Cattle Basis Prices 1
affiliations: University of Arkansas, Fayetteville - Department of Agricultural Economics & Agribusiness and University of Arkansas, Fayetteville - Department of Agricultural Economics & Agribusiness

detail.title: Screwworm Border Closure and Cattle Prices Heterogeneous Spatio-Temporal Effects of the Screwworm-Induced Border Closure on US Cattle Basis Prices 1
detail.abstract: The U.S. suspended imports of live cattle from Mexico beginning in 2024 following the detection of New World Screwworm (NWS) in Mexico. This measure was an effort to prevent an outbreak of NWS into the U.S., which could cause significant economic losses. Mexican cattle are an important source of feeder cattle supplies for the U.S., and closing the border represents a major supply shock. We quantify the impacts of closing the border on domestic cattle markets. We find that feeder cattle basis strengthened following the closure. The magnitude of this effect depends on a market's proximity to the border and the duration of the closure.

AI.tldr: 本文量化分析了美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）疫情暂停进口墨西哥活牛对国内肉牛市场的影响，发现关闭边境导致美国国内架子牛基差增强，且影响程度取决于市场距墨西哥边境的距离和关闭持续时间。
AI.research_question: 美国暂停进口墨西哥活牛对国内肉牛市场产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 墨西哥活牛是美国重要的架子牛供应来源，关闭边境构成重大供给冲击，需要量化评估其对国内市场的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易壁垒与供给冲击理论、区域市场联动与空间经济理论。
AI.method: 量化分析，通过比较边境关闭前后不同区域市场的架子牛基差变化来评估影响。
AI.findings: 关闭边境后美国架子牛基差增强；影响程度与市场距墨西哥边境的距离和关闭持续时间相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易壁垒对区域农产品市场的异质性影响提供了实证证据，丰富了供给冲击的空间传导机制研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国畜牧行业应对边境关闭等贸易中断事件提供了量化参考，帮助理解不同区域市场的差异化风险暴露。

title: Inside the Rookie Contract Window: Quantifying the Time-to-Leap and Development Trajectories of Modern NBA Lottery Selections
affiliations: , University of California, San Diego (UCSD), University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: Inside the Rookie Contract Window: Quantifying the Time-to-Leap and Development Trajectories of Modern NBA Lottery Selections
detail.abstract: This study investigates the developmental trajectories and time-to-leap of National Basketball Association (NBA) lottery selections (picks 1-14) within their rookie contract window. Utilizing a 15 year sample from 2007-08 to 2021-22 (n = 177), this study tracks the probability and timeframe of a player reaching all-star caliber productivity, defined by an objective proxy threshold of Player Efficiency Rating (PER ≥ 20). A Kaplan-Meier survival analysis was leveraged to analyze these timelines, aggregating by player position, rookie age, and draft status, alongside a Cox Proportional Hazards model to evaluate the impact of early career statistical growth covariates. Survival analyses reveal distinct discrepancies across cohorts based on different demographic features. Position wise, Bigs drastically outperform their counterparts in achieving a 40.63% event hit rate by Year 5, compared to 27.47% for Guards and 16.66% for Forwards. Furthermore, players entering the league at ages 20 and 21 yield the highest breakthrough rates by Year 5 (34.98% and 36.77%), and Top 5 draft selections reach all-star productivity at a higher rate (36.08%) than the remaining lottery (19.85%). The CPH model demonstrates that a players Year 2 free throw rate and usage rate growth with respect to their Year 1 usage rate are highly predictive, with a one unit increase in Δ USG increasing breakthrough probability by 22.9% (p = 0.000), while a 1% increase in Year 2 free throw rate increasing breakthrough rate by 4.6% (p = 0.001).

AI.tldr: 本研究利用NBA 15年（2007-2021）乐透选秀数据（n=177），采用Kaplan-Meier生存分析与Cox比例风险模型，追踪新秀合同期内球员达到全明星级生产力（PER≥20）的发展轨迹与时间节点。研究发现：大个子球员5年内达标率（40.63%）显著高于后卫（27.47%）和前锋（16.66%）；20-21岁进入联盟的球员突破率最高；前5顺位球员达标率（36.08%）优于后9顺位（19.85%）；第二年罚球率与使用率增长（ΔUSG）是突破的最强预测指标（ΔUSG每增加1单位，突破概率提升22.9%）。
AI.research_question: NBA乐透新秀（前14顺位）在新秀合同期内达到全明星级生产力的发展轨迹与时间跨度如何？不同位置、年龄、选秀顺位的球员在突破时间上是否存在显著差异？哪些早期职业生涯统计指标能预测这一突破？
AI.motivation: NBA乐透选秀是球队重建的核心资源，但新秀发展轨迹存在高度不确定性。理解球员达到全明星水平的概率和时间窗口，对于球队的球员培养策略、合同决策和长期规划至关重要。现有研究多聚焦选秀结果预测，缺乏对球员发展动态过程的纵向分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 球员发展轨迹理论、人力资本积累理论、生存分析模型（Kaplan-Meier估计、Cox比例风险模型）
AI.method: 样本：2007-08至2021-22赛季177名NBA乐透新秀；因变量：新秀合同期内PER≥20的全明星级生产力（首次达标时间）；方法：Kaplan-Meier生存分析估计不同组别（位置、年龄、顺位）的累计达标概率；Cox比例风险模型评估早期统计增长协变量（第二年罚球率、使用率变化ΔUSG等）对突破风险比的影响。
AI.findings: （1）位置差异：Bigs（内线球员）5年达标率40.63%，后卫27.47%，前锋仅16.66%；（2）年龄效应：20岁和21岁进入联盟的球员5年突破率最高（34.98%和36.77%）；（3）顺位效应：前5顺位5年达标率36.08%，后9顺位仅19.85%；（4）预测指标：ΔUSG每增加1单位，突破概率提升22.9%（p=0.000）；第二年罚球率每增加1%，突破率提升4.6%（p=0.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生存分析方法引入体育人才发展研究，为球员发展轨迹提供了动态时间维度的理论框架；识别了影响球员突破的关键预测变量（使用率增长、罚球率），丰富了球员人力资本积累与绩效突破的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NBA球队提供数据驱动的选秀评估与球员发展决策依据：内线球员的发展确定性更高；20-21岁是选秀最佳年龄窗口；前5顺位的投资回报率显著高于后段乐透；建议球队重点关注新秀第二年的使用率增长和罚球表现作为早期潜力信号。

title: The Role of Agriculture, Industry, and Services Sector in the Economic Growth of Bangladesh: An ARDL Approach
affiliations: Center for Policy and Economic Research (CPER)

detail.title: The Role of Agriculture, Industry, and Services Sector in the Economic Growth of Bangladesh: An ARDL Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could appear to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on publicly available secondary time-series data on Bangladesh’s macroeconomic indicators and does not involve human participants. Therefore, ethical approval was not required under institutional and international research ethics guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or nonprofit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Purpose - This study investigates the contributions of agriculture, industry, and services to Bangladesh’s economic growth, addressing controversies regarding their short- and long-run impacts within the framework of structural transformation.

Design/methodology/approach - Using annual time-series data from 1971–2020, the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach was employed to estimate both long-run elasticities and short-run dynamics. Complementary diagnostic and stability tests ensured robustness of the model.

Findings - Results confirm a strong long-run cointegrating relationship between GDP and the three sectors. Services emerged as the dominant driver of growth, industry contributed positively but moderately, and agriculture remained vital in both the short and long run. The error correction term indicated rapid adjustment toward equilibrium, underscoring resilience in Bangladesh’s growth process.

Research limitations - The study is limited to aggregate sectoral data, which may mask heterogeneity within subsectors. External shocks such as climate change and global trade disruptions were not explicitly modeled.

Originality/value - By jointly analyzing agriculture, industry, and services within a unified ARDL framework, this study reconciles econometric evidence with structural transformation theory, offering evidence-based insights for balanced sectoral development in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 利用孟加拉国1971-2020年时间序列数据，采用ARDL边界检验法，发现服务业是经济增长的主要驱动力，工业贡献中等，农业在长短期均保持重要地位，三国之间存在长期协整关系。
AI.research_question: 农业、工业和服务业对孟加拉国经济增长的短期与长期贡献如何？
AI.motivation: 关于三大产业对孟加拉国经济增长的短期和长期影响存在争议，且缺乏在结构转型框架下的统一实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构转型理论（Structural Transformation Theory）
AI.method: 采用1971-2020年年度时间序列数据，运用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法估计长期弹性和短期动态，辅以诊断检验和稳定性检验。
AI.findings: （1）GDP与三大产业间存在长期协整关系；（2）服务业是经济增长的主导驱动力；（3）工业贡献为正向但中等；（4）农业在短期和长期均保持重要地位；（5）误差修正项表明向均衡调整速度较快，经济增长过程具有韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 在统一ARDL框架下联合分析三大产业，将计量经济学证据与结构转型理论相调和，为平衡的部门发展提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国制定平衡的产业发展政策提供了基于证据的见解，揭示了服务业的主导作用及农业的持续重要性，有助于决策者优化资源配置。

title: How Long Does It Take to Sell Your Products?
affiliations: Northwestern University - Department of Operations and University of Amsterdam - Korteweg-de Vries Institute for Mathematics

detail.title: How Long Does It Take to Sell Your Products?
detail.abstract: We study the pricing problem of a seller with finite inventory over a finite sales horizon. Customers arrive according to a Poisson process and have valuations drawn from short-tailed, light-tailed, or heavy-tailed distributions, corresponding to the standard classes in Extreme Value Theory. Our focus is on the normalized time required to sell k out of q products in an asymptotic regime in which the sales horizon becomes large. Under optimal static pricing, we show that for short-tailed and light-tailed valuations, the time required to sell k products converges to zero, both in distribution and in expectation. For heavy-tailed valuations, by contrast, the limiting distribution is non-degenerate but exhibits a positive probability of unsold inventory. Under optimal dynamic pricing, we show that the time of the kth sale converges to an expression that involves a product of Beta random variables, whose parameters are determined by the tail class of the valuation distribution. In the light-tailed case, this reduces to the kth order statistic of a uniform distribution, implying that sales are asymptotically optimally balanced over the available horizon. For short-tailed and heavy-tailed valuations, the corresponding distributions are shifted slightly earlier and later, respectively, within the sales horizon. In addition, we show that sales times admit a natural interpretation on a logarithmic time scale, derive comparative statics, and demonstrate that, in general, static pricing cannot be said to be uniformly faster or slower than dynamic pricing. Our results address the question of what constitutes the "right time" to sell a product and provide practitioners with insights into expected sales patterns, which may contribute to greater compliance and trust in pricing software.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限库存和有限销售期内的定价问题，分析了在短尾、轻尾和重尾估值分布下，销售k件商品所需时间的渐近性质。发现在最优静态定价下，短尾和轻尾分布的销售时间趋于零；重尾分布则呈现非退化分布且存在库存滞销概率。最优动态定价下，销售时间可表示为贝塔随机变量的乘积。研究为“何时卖出合适”提供了理论依据。
AI.research_question: 在有限库存和有限销售期内，不同类型估值分布（短尾、轻尾、重尾）下，销售一定数量商品所需的时间具有怎样的渐近性质？
AI.motivation: 实际销售中，定价策略与销售时间的关系是核心问题，但不同估值分布下销售时间的渐近行为尚未得到系统刻画，且静态定价与动态定价的相对速度也缺乏理论比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）、泊松过程、最优静态定价与动态定价、贝塔随机变量。
AI.method: 基于极值理论对估值分布进行分类（短尾、轻尾、重尾），构建泊松到达模型，分别在最优静态定价和最优动态定价下，推导销售时间的渐近分布和期望。
AI.findings: 1) 静态定价下，短尾和轻尾估值分布使得销售时间趋于零；重尾分布下销售时间呈非退化分布且存在滞销概率。2) 动态定价下，销售时间收敛于贝塔随机变量乘积，轻尾情形退化为均匀分布的顺序统计量。3) 短尾和重尾分布分别使销售时间提前或推迟。4) 静态定价和动态定价各有快慢，无法一概而论。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将极值理论系统引入定价-销售时间分析，揭示了估值尾部分类对销售时间渐近行为的决定性影响，并建立了动态定价下销售时间与贝塔随机变量乘积的精确关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了不同市场条件下销售时间模式的预测工具，有助于优化定价策略选择，增强定价软件的信任度和合规性。

title: Seeking the Rent Seekers: Optimal Life Cycle Taxation with Differentiated Human Capital
affiliations: Federal Housing Finance Agency

detail.title: Seeking the Rent Seekers: Optimal Life Cycle Taxation with Differentiated Human Capital
detail.abstract: This paper studies optimal dynamic income taxation in a life cycle model with differentiated skills. Imperfect substitution in worker types gives rise to spillover effects in general equilibrium wages from higher aggregate output. A novel Monte Carlo method is developed using multilayered neural networks to compute optimal history-dependent income taxes within a very general class of tax functions. The welfare gains from history-dependent taxation are found to be large, equivalent to a 2 percent increase in lifetime consumption compared to the optimal tax on current income. The welfare gains are found to be close to zero without these features.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了生命周期模型中不同技能类型劳动力的最优动态所得税问题。通过多层神经网络开发了一种新颖的蒙特卡洛方法，计算最优历史依赖型所得税。研究发现，与最优的当前收入税相比，历史依赖型税收能带来显著的福利收益（相当于终身消费增加2%），但没有这些特征时福利收益接近零。
AI.research_question: 在具有不同技能类型的生命周期一般均衡模型中，最优动态所得税（历史依赖型税收）如何设计？其福利收益有多大？
AI.motivation: 传统的动态税收理论多假设完美替代或简化设定，忽略了不同技能类型劳动力之间不完全替代带来的一般均衡溢出效应。本文旨在更真实地刻画技能异质性和一般均衡反馈，并利用机器学习方法求解复杂的历史依赖型最优税收问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期模型、不同技能类型劳动力的不完全替代、一般均衡工资溢出效应、历史依赖型税收理论。
AI.method: 使用多层神经网络开发了新颖的蒙特卡洛方法，在非常一般的税收函数类别中计算最优历史依赖型所得税。
AI.findings: (1) 历史依赖型税收相比最优的当前收入税能带来显著的福利收益，相当于终身消费增加2%；(2) 如果没有上述特征（技能异质性和一般均衡效应），历史依赖型税收的福利收益接近于零。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多层神经网络蒙特卡洛方法应用于动态最优税收问题求解；揭示了在技能异质性和一般均衡溢出效应存在时，历史依赖型税收具有显著福利收益的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更高效的所得税制度提供了理论依据——当考虑不同技能类型劳动力的相互影响时，历史依赖型税收（如基于过去收入记录征税）可以显著提高社会福利。

title: Judicial Decisions Under Pressure: Evidence from the Chinese Judiciary

detail.title: Judicial Decisions Under Pressure: Evidence from the Chinese Judiciary
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether caseload pressure changes appellate decision-making. Using 3.3 million Chinese civil appellate decisions from 2013 to 2021, I link appellate outcomes to judge-level workload and written reasoning. I instrument a presiding judge's caseload with the leave-one-out workload of other presiding judges in the same court and month. A doubling of appellate caseload increases the probability that the appellate court upholds the first-instance judgment by about 0.7 percentage points. Heavier caseloads also reduce legal citations and increase textual similarity between first-and second-instance reasoning. The results show that court congestion changes not only how quickly courts process disputes, but also how intensively appellate judges review lower-court decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2013-2021年间330万份中国民事上诉判决书，研究发现法官案件负荷每增加一倍，维持原判的概率上升约0.7个百分点，同时法律引用减少、一二审推理文本相似度增加，表明案件负担不仅影响审理速度，也实质性削弱了上诉审查的深度。
AI.research_question: 案件负荷压力如何改变上诉法院的决策行为？
AI.motivation: 理解法院拥堵是否不仅影响案件处理速度，还会实质性改变上诉法官对下级法院判决的审查强度和质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法决策的行为经济学视角，关注工作量约束对法官认知资源和决策质量的影响；工具变量法处理内生性问题。
AI.method: 利用2013-2021年中国330万份民事上诉判决书，将上诉结果与法官层面的工作量和书面推理相关联；采用同一法院同一月份其他主审法官的留一法工作量作为工具变量。
AI.findings: 案件负荷每增加一倍，上诉法院维持原判的概率上升约0.7个百分点；案件负荷加重会减少法律引用数量，并增加一审与二审推理文本之间的相似度。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论上证实了案件负荷不仅影响司法效率（速度），还会影响司法质量（审查深度），扩展了关于司法决策中制度性约束因素的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院资源分配、案件管理改革和法官工作量设定提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需关注案件负荷对上诉审查实质性的负面影响。

title: How Long Does It Take to Sell Your Products?
affiliations: University of Amsterdam - Korteweg-de Vries Institute for Mathematics and Northwestern University - Department of Operations

detail.title: How Long Does It Take to Sell Your Products?
detail.abstract: We study the pricing problem of a seller with finite inventory over a finite sales horizon. Customers arrive according to a Poisson process and have valuations drawn from short-tailed, light-tailed, or heavy-tailed distributions, corresponding to the standard classes in Extreme Value Theory. Our focus is on the normalized time required to sell k out of q products in an asymptotic regime in which the sales horizon becomes large. Under optimal static pricing, we show that for short-tailed and light-tailed valuations, the time required to sell k products converges to zero, both in distribution and in expectation. For heavy-tailed valuations, by contrast, the limiting distribution is non-degenerate but exhibits a positive probability of unsold inventory. Under optimal dynamic pricing, we show that the time of the kth sale converges to an expression that involves a product of Beta random variables, whose parameters are determined by the tail class of the valuation distribution. In the light-tailed case, this reduces to the kth order statistic of a uniform distribution, implying that sales are asymptotically optimally balanced over the available horizon. For short-tailed and heavy-tailed valuations, the corresponding distributions are shifted slightly earlier and later, respectively, within the sales horizon. In addition, we show that sales times admit a natural interpretation on a logarithmic time scale, derive comparative statics, and demonstrate that, in general, static pricing cannot be said to be uniformly faster or slower than dynamic pricing. Our results address the question of what constitutes the "right time" to sell a product and provide practitioners with insights into expected sales patterns, which may contribute to greater compliance and trust in pricing software.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限库存和有限销售期下卖家的定价问题，分析了顾客估值分布尾部特征（短尾、轻尾、重尾）对销售时间的影响，发现静态定价下重尾分布会导致未售库存，动态定价下销售时间可表示为Beta随机变量乘积，并揭示了不同尾部类别下的最优销售节奏。
AI.research_question: 在有限库存和有限销售期内，当顾客估值服从不同尾部类别（短尾、轻尾、重尾）分布时，卖家应如何定价，以及销售k件产品所需时间的渐近性质是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有定价文献大多关注最优价格和收益，但对实际销售时间模式（即"何时售出"）的刻画不足。在销售期有限且库存有限的现实场景中，理解销售时间分布对库存管理、定价策略和消费者信任至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）中的尾部分类（短尾、轻尾、重尾）；Poisson到达过程；最优静态定价与最优动态定价；Beta随机变量与顺序统计量。
AI.method: 理论建模与渐近分析：在销售期趋于无穷大的渐近框架下，利用极值理论对估值分布尾部进行分类，分别推导静态定价和动态定价下第k次销售时间的极限分布和期望。
AI.findings: 静态定价下：短尾和轻尾估值分布中，销售时间趋于零；重尾分布中，极限分布非退化但存在正概率的未售库存。动态定价下：销售时间收敛到Beta随机变量乘积的形式；轻尾下退化为均匀分布的顺序统计量，销售节奏最优平衡；短尾和重尾分别使销售时间略早和略晚。此外，静态与动态定价的速度比较不具有一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将极值理论的尾部分类引入动态定价模型，刻画了估值分布尾部特征对销售时间渐近行为的系统性影响，建立了定价策略、库存销售与极值分布之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了"何时售出"的定量预测工具，帮助理解不同市场环境下的预期销售模式，从而提高对定价软件的信任和合规度，并为库存管理和定价决策提供理论指导。

detail.abstract: The theory about reducing risk via portfolio diversification is so well-known that it has become financial conventional wisdom. Less well-known is the economic theory about partners along a supply chain and why partnering is more efficient than doing it all on your own. “How do firms choose trade partners?” is not an easy question to answer, but, as it turns out, is related to the theory of portfolio diversification. Understanding both of these theories is important to understanding how trade agreements impact market structure. 1 Firms interacting with each other along a supply chain–taking advantage of the benefits of specialization– reduces transactions costs. The profitability of value-added products is incentivized in these supply-chain relationships as trust along the chain increases.2 Contracts, especially those that are long established and with legally enforceable provisions, increase trust. With binding contracts, firms are able to meet the needs of other actors along the supply chain and tailor their products for specific needs thus increasing the value of the good. What happens when the contracts cannot be relied upon? Two possibilities emerge. When partnerships become unreliable, to mitigate risk firms either 1) go looking for other partners or 2) try to manage more of their supply chain internally.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了供应链中的伙伴关系如何降低交易成本、提升产品价值，以及当合同不可靠时企业如何通过寻找新伙伴或内部化管理来应对风险，并与投资组合多元化理论相关联。
AI.research_question: 企业如何选择贸易伙伴？当合同不可靠时，企业会采取什么策略来应对供应链中的风险？
AI.motivation: 尽管投资组合多元化理论广为人知，但供应链中伙伴关系的经济学理论及其与风险分散的关系尚不为人熟知。理解这些理论对于理解贸易协定如何影响市场结构至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合多元化理论；供应链伙伴关系理论；交易成本理论；合同与信任理论。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于经济学理论推演。

title:
Regression Discontinuity Designs under Treatment-based Sampling: 
Fuzzy RD estimands, Reweighted Inference, and Density Diagnostics

detail.title:
Regression Discontinuity Designs under Treatment-based Sampling: 
Fuzzy RD estimands, Reweighted Inference, and Density Diagnostics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses theoretical analysis and simulated data only and does not involve human participants or personal data. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper studies regression discontinuity (RD) designs when the analysis sample is stratified on realized treatment status. Treatment-based sampling is common in program evaluation when treated units are rare, policy-relevant, or observed more intensively than nonparticipants. We show that the sharp RD treatment-effect estimand is preserved under such sampling, but the sampled density of the running variable may exhibit a mechanical discontinuity at the cutoff even when the population density is continuous. In fuzzy RD designs, the conventional local Wald ratio generally fails to identify the population complier effect at the cutoff. We derive an explicit principal-strata decomposition of the resulting bias and propose a reweighted fuzzy RD estimand that restores identification when the population treatment share is known, externally estimable, or treated as a sensitivity parameter. We develop weighted local-linear estimation, consistency, asymptotic bias and variance formulas, and a robust bias-corrected inference connection. Finally, we construct a reweighted density-continuity diagnostic that targets the population running-variable density rather than the distorted sample density and adapt local-polynomial density-discontinuity inference to this setting. Unlike standard IV settings, RD designs also rely on density-continuity diagnostics, so treatment-based sampling affects both the causal estimand in fuzzy RD and the diagnostic evidence used to validate the design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在分析样本按实际处理状态分层时（即处理组样本过度采样），断点回归设计（RD）的性质与修正方法。结果表明：清晰RD的处理效应估计量保持不变，但运行变量的样本密度在断点处可能出现机械性不连续；模糊RD的传统Wald比会失效；作者提出了再加权估计量以恢复识别，并开发了相应的加权局部线性估计与稳健推断方法。
AI.research_question: 在按实际处理状态分层的样本下（处理组过度采样），断点回归设计的识别与推断是否会受到影响？若受影响，如何修正？
AI.motivation: 在政策评估中，处理组单位往往稀缺、受政策关注或观测强度高于非参与者，因此研究者常按处理状态分层抽样。但现有RD文献缺乏对这种常见抽样实践的理论分析，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 断点回归设计（清晰RD与模糊RD）、局部Wald比、主分层分解（principal-strata decomposition）、加权局部线性估计、密度连续性诊断。
AI.method: 理论推导（识别条件、偏差分解）、加权局部线性回归估计、渐近理论与稳健偏差校正推断；并构建了针对总体运行变量密度而非扭曲样本密度的再加权密度连续性诊断方法。
AI.findings: （1）清晰RD的处理效应估计量在按处理状态分层抽样下保持不变；（2）但运行变量样本密度会在断点处出现机械性不连续；（3）模糊RD中，传统局部Wald比无法识别总体依从者处理效应；（4）当总体处理份额已知、可外部估计或作为敏感性参数时，再加权模糊RD估计量可恢复识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析了按处理状态分层抽样对RD设计识别与推断的影响；揭示了模糊RD中Wald比偏差的主分层来源；提出了再加权识别策略及其渐近理论；扩展了密度连续性诊断方法以适应扭曲样本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用处理组过度抽样数据的实证研究者提供了可操作的估计与推断方法（加权局部线性估计、偏差校正推断、再加权密度诊断），有助于在罕见处理或重点处理情境下正确使用RD设计。

title: Jobs and Value Added from Agricultural Production, Processing, and Services in Iowa, 2025

detail.title: Jobs and Value Added from Agricultural Production, Processing, and Services in Iowa, 2025

publicationDetails.detailsText: Crespi, J.M. 2025. “Jobs and Value Added from Agricultural Production, Processing, and Services in Iowa, 2025.” Policy brief 25-PB 49. Center for Agricultural and Rural Development, Iowa State University.

detail.abstract: For this policy brief, I estimated the impact to Iowa’s State Gross Domestic Product (GDP), or “value added” for 60 industries encompassing agricultural production, processing or agricultural adjacent industries. Value added is the contribution to GDP, the difference between the sales output and the cost of intermediate inputs used to produce the output. I used an economic impact model maintained by the IMPLAN Group, LLC, Huntersville, NC (IMPLAN), which is often called an input-output (IO) production model. In this model, think of all industries in the economy as feeding inputs into each other to produce outputs that are then sold to consumers or sold to another industry along a supply chain. IO models make adjustments for imports and exports as well as government services while accounting for employment and taxes to the various industrial sectors in order to calculate how much additional value is added to the economy, as opposed to only examining sales receipts. IO models determine the linkages between and among different industries in the production of goods and services in the economy and can measure how dollars spent in one industry impact another. My definition of agricultural industries includes farm production (e.g., soybeans), processing of production into a new, manufactured product (e.g., soymeal, biodiesel), as well as the creation of products used in agricultural production (e.g., nitrogen fertilizer) and affiliated services like veterinary services. The specific industries as well as their general definitions are shown in table 1. I based my definitions on those provided by IMPLAN. Along with the IMPLAN industry codes, table 1 also provides the 6-digit North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) codes. Readers curious about the components of each industry can consult the documentation provided by these two establishments for more detail.1 One thing to notice is that some industries are quite broad. Ethanol, for example, is encompassed in the larger “other organic chemical” industry. Researchers are limited to the industries as defined by the NAICS and the government agencies that collect the data, and although future research could attempt to create specific industries in IO models, I do not attempt to do so here.

AI.tldr: 本文利用IMPLAN投入产出模型，估算了爱荷华州60个农业相关产业对州GDP（增加值）的经济影响，明确了农业产业链中生产、加工、服务等环节的贡献。
AI.research_question: 爱荷华州60个农业相关产业（包括农业生产、加工、农业投入品及附属服务）对该州GDP（增加值）的经济影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者需要了解农业产业链各环节对州经济的真实贡献（而非仅看销售收入），以便制定有针对性的农业经济政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出（Input-Output, IO）模型理论，该理论通过分析产业间的投入-产出关联、进出口和政府服务调整，计算各产业对GDP的增加值贡献。
AI.method: 使用IMPLAN集团维护的经济影响模型（投入产出模型），基于IMPLAN行业代码和北美工业分类系统（NAICS）代码，对60个农业相关产业的增加值进行估算。
AI.findings: 论文提供了爱荷华州60个农业相关产业（包括农场生产、加工制造如豆粕和生物柴油、农业投入品如氮肥、以及兽医等附属服务）对州GDP的增加值估算结果，揭示了各产业间的经济关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了投入产出模型在区域农业经济影响评估中的具体应用，验证了IO模型在区分增加值与销售收入上的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为爱荷华州政策制定者提供了农业产业链各环节对GDP贡献的量化数据，有助于更精准地制定农业扶持政策；同时指出了NAICS分类对行业细分的局限性（如乙醇被归入“其他有机化工”大类）。

title: Climate Change Perceptions, Access to Weather Information, Farming Adaptation Practices and Rainfall Shocks: Evidence from Smallholders Agriculture of Benin, West Africa

detail.title: Climate Change Perceptions, Access to Weather Information, Farming Adaptation Practices and Rainfall Shocks: Evidence from Smallholders Agriculture of Benin, West Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Informed consent was obtained from all surveyed participants prior to data collection. No personally identifiable information was recorded.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: Climate variability has substantially altered the livelihood of smallholder communities, especially in developing countries of Sub-Saharan African countries, where agriculture is mostly rainfed. In the pursuit of coping mechanisms, the most plausible avenues for farmers to increase their overall crop production include cropland expansion at the expanse of natural forest resources. Locally, climate variability perception within farming communities had not been sufficiently documented in developing countries. This is fundamentally due to data scarcity. Yet, such information is urgently needed to support the implementation of climate adaptation projects, both at sub-municipality and district levels. Here, using a semi-structure questionnaire administered to the farming community in Benin, a random sub-sample of 236 farmers was selected. To this survey data, historical precipitation data was complemented, spanning from 1990 to 2021, using selected farmers household locations during the growing season of year 2021, to compute the relative deviation from historical (30 years) seasonal trend. Descriptive statistics reveal that most farmers perceive the impact of climate variability, while a non-negligible proportion does not have access to weather information. There is a positive correlation between farmers who use organic fertilizer and the decrease in rainfall perception, corroborating that access to weather information would be helpful to smallholder farmers. Sensitivity to climate variability varies based on gender, indicating the necessity of agricultural extension services. This study demonstrates that smallholder farmers in Benin are negatively affected by rainfall shocks, which is a major contributor to migration and decrease in yields of dominant crops. A seasonal modeling framework is therefore necessary to further understand effects of climate variables on sub-national variations of crop production.

AI.tldr: 本文利用贝宁236名农户的问卷调查和30年历史降水数据，揭示了小农户对气候变率的感知现状，发现部分农民缺乏气象信息获取渠道，使用有机肥与降水减少感知呈正相关，气候敏感性存在性别差异，降雨冲击对农业生产和人口迁移产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家（以贝宁为例）小农户对气候变率的感知如何？这种感知差异受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 气候变率显著改变了小农户的生计，但发展中国家农户对气候变率的感知尚未得到充分记录，而这类信息对于实施气候适应项目至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变率感知理论、农户适应行为理论、性别与气候敏感性差异理论
AI.method: 采用半结构化问卷调查（n=236），结合1990-2021年30年历史降水数据，通过描述性统计和相关分析探究农户对气候变率的感知及其影响因素。
AI.findings: 大多数农户感知到气候变率的影响，但相当比例的农户无法获得气象信息；使用有机肥的农户与降雨减少感知呈正相关；气候敏感性存在性别差异；降雨冲击是导致人口迁移和主要作物减产的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家小农户气候感知的实证证据，揭示了气象信息获取、有机肥使用与气候感知之间的关联机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贝宁等撒哈拉以南非洲国家的气候适应项目设计和农业推广服务提供了政策依据，强调了改善气象信息服务、关注性别差异的必要性。

title: Electric Vehicle Charging Behavior and Grid Reliability: A 50-State Analysis of Peak Demand and Infrastructure Requirements, 2026 to 2040

detail.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Behavior and Grid Reliability: A 50-State Analysis of Peak Demand and Infrastructure Requirements, 2026 to 2040

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available aggregate data and does not involve human participants, human subjects, personal data, or identifiable individual information. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) charging can significantly reshape peak electricity demand, yet most studies evaluate its impacts at either the bulk transmission or distribution level alone. This separation can obscure important tradeoffs between system-wide peak reduction and local load synchronization. This study evaluates the peak-demand impacts of light-duty battery electric vehicles across all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia from 2026 to 2040 using a dual-metric framework that captures both bulk-system peak exposure, via a Peak Alignment Factor (PAF), and distribution-level load synchronization, via the traditional coincidence factor (CF). The results show that charging behavior is a larger determinant of peak demand than adoption itself. Under the base adoption scenario, unmanaged charging increases the non-coincident national peak by 59.9 GW by 2040 (59.2 GW coincident peak), while fully managed charging reduces this increase to 27.6 GW (28.5 GW coincident peak). Time-of-use (TOU) pricing minimizes it to 21.6 GW (21.4 GW coincident), but concentrates charging into the same overnight hours, producing a combined 189 GW non-coincident charging peak (97.8 GW coincident), compared with 72 GW under unmanaged charging. In six states, California, Colorado, New Jersey, Michigan, New York, and Hawaii, this synchronized midnight peak exceeds the existing evening peak and becomes a new system peak. Strategies that reduce transmission-level stress can raise distribution-level stress by concentrating charging into the same hours. By combining both metrics, the framework reveals a transmission-distribution tradeoff that single-metric approaches cannot detect. Among the strategies evaluated, only fully managed charging improves both at once. The results provide a nationwide basis for EV charging policy, infrastructure planning, and grid-reliability strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个双指标框架（PAF和CF），评估美国50州及DC地区2026-2040年电动汽车充电对高峰用电需求的影响，发现充电行为比电动车普及率更能影响峰值需求，并揭示了传输网与配电网之间的关键权衡：单一指标方法无法捕捉到这一权衡，只有完全受控充电能同时改善两个指标。
AI.research_question: 电动汽车充电如何同时在输电网（系统级）和配电网（本地级）两个层面影响峰值电力需求？两种层面之间存在怎样的权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多单独评估电动汽车充电对输电网或配电网的影响，这种分离可能掩盖系统级峰值降低与本地负荷同步之间的重要权衡，因此需要一种能够同时捕捉两个层面影响的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双指标框架：1) 峰值对齐因子（Peak Alignment Factor, PAF）——衡量充电负荷与输电网系统峰值的对齐程度；2) 传统重合系数（Coincidence Factor, CF）——衡量配电网层面负荷的同步化程度。
AI.method: 对美国50个州及哥伦比亚特区2026-2040年轻型电池电动汽车的充电场景进行建模，采用双指标框架（PAF和CF）评估不同充电管理策略（无管理、完全管理、分时电价）对峰荷的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 充电行为比电动汽车普及率对峰值需求影响更大；2) 分时电价虽能最小化系统级峰值，但会导致充电集中在深夜时段，产生巨大的非重合充电峰值（189 GW vs 无管理的72 GW）；3) 六个州的同步午夜峰值超过原有晚间峰值成为新系统峰值；4) 减少输电网压力的策略可能增加配电网压力，存在传输-配电权衡；5) 只有完全受控充电能同时改善两个指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了同时评估输电网与配电网层面峰值影响的PAF-CF双指标框架，揭示了单指标方法无法识别的传输-配电权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国全国范围的电动汽车充电政策、基础设施规划和电网可靠性战略提供了基于数据的决策依据；指出分时电价策略可能带来的配电网风险，并强调完全受控充电策略的优越性。
